gen-comfortaa-gf-m-plus-rounded-1c: Comfortaa draws its letters like glowing tube lettering, one gentle line thickness all the way round, with a ring-shaped c. M PLUS Rounded 1c is the softer, more varied sans-serif beneath it, and that gap is what holds the pair together.
gen-comfortaa-gf-manjari: Manjari takes the body role with curves that stay open at the ends and a line that never swells or thins. Manjari handles the quiet reading, while Comfortaa, stretched out like an uncoiled spring, is the one that makes a display statement.
gen-comfortaa-gf-meera-inimai: Friendly is the first word that comes to mind for Comfortaa, with its ring-shaped c and glowing, tube-like strokes. Meera Inimai follows in open-ended curves and a constant, blueprint-like line, so a long passage moves along without any fuss.
gen-comfortaa-gf-metrophobic: Comfortaa's c is a wide-open ring, and every stroke has the same smooth, thickness-free feel of a neon tube. Metrophobic then carries the reading, sending each bend along a smooth, unobstructed path so a long passage glides.
gen-comfortaa-gf-mina: Comfortaa's ring-shaped c and spring-loose spacing give its glowing, tube-drawn strokes an instantly friendly look at display size. Mina keeps things plain.
gen-comfortaa-gf-mingzat: Mingzat brings curvy, unclamped letters to the body text, quite different from the stretched-out spacing of Comfortaa above it. And since its shapes are so loose, a slightly larger body size would let them breathe.
gen-comfortaa-gf-moderustic: Comfortaa draws every letter like an outline in one width. Its wide ring of a c does the display work, while Moderustic, with curves traced by a broad nib and left unfinished, is the one built for running text.
gen-comfortaa-gf-molengo: Friendly describes Comfortaa well, with its ring-shaped c and strokes that all look cut to one width, like neon tubing. Comfortaa takes the showpiece job; Molengo, with wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp, does the quiet work.
gen-comfortaa-gf-momo-trust-sans: Neon-tube friendly, Comfortaa stretches its letters out around a ring-shaped c, with Momo Trust Sans underneath, heavy in the bowls. Body text there may like a size up.
gen-comfortaa-gf-mona-sans: Mona Sans opens the pair with letter openings as wide as a door left ajar, plainly set below Comfortaa's ring-shaped c. Mona Sans keeps a longer passage moving easily, while the heading's strokes stay contrast-free from stem to terminal.
